description: This source file defines a React component named 'ResizableSplitPane' that provides a resizable split pane layout with optional collapse behavior. It manages resizing interactions, orientation (horizontal or vertical), and collapsibility features. Additionally, it exports a custom hook 'useResponsiveSplitPane' for responsive adjustments based on screen size.
